g.title: aeris10_signal_and_data_flow
g.text: AERIS-10 - Signal and data flow (RF / IF / clock / digital)
Drawing ID: SYS-03 Revision: A Date: 2026-10-09 Status: SOURCE-DERIVED; frequencies are firmware-programmed values, not measurements

Source: RADAR_Main_Board.sch (nets traced through passives), Clocks_Freq_Synth_board.sch, RF_PA.sch; main.cpp:190 (IF_freq 120 MHz), main.cpp:933-1072 (AD9523: VCXO 100 MHz, PLL2 3.6 GHz, channel dividers), adf4382a_manager.h:32-34 (REF 300 MHz, TX 10.5 GHz, RX 10.38 GHz); radar_system_top.v (ports, clk_100m, clk_120m_dac); docs/SYSTEM/BLOCK_DIAGRAM.md section 3
Legend: solid = confirmed | dashed = unverified | dotted red = missing specification / no hardware | black = RF/IF | green = clock | blue = digital data/control | grey = node is off-board/no CAD

g.title: cluster_clk
g.text: Frequency Synthesizer Board - reference and clock tree

g.title: cluster_fe
g.text: Main Board - common port, beamformers, front ends

g.title: ad9523
g.text: PLL2: PFD 100 MHz, N=36 -> VCO 3.6 GHz (main.cpp:944-946)

g.title: osc_x6
g.text: K7: part value 50 MHz vs net/firmware 100 MHz

g.title: lotx
g.text: RFOUT1 -> C64/C65 -> U2 MTX2-143+ -> U4 ATS1005 -3 dB -> J10 'LO TX'
RFOUT2 -> U3 -> U5 -> J1 'AUX. LO TX'

g.title: lorx
g.text: RFOUT1 -> C87/C88 -> U7 MTX2-143+ -> U8 ATS1005 -> J11 'LO RX'

g.title: adc
g.text: D0..7 +/-, DCO +/-, OR +/- LVDS (series R2..R12) -> U42 bank 14

g.title: out4->adc
g.text: J3 -> J21 twinax, 400 MHz LVDS (sample clock)

g.title: out5->fpga_rx
g.text: J4 -> J19 twinax, 400 MHz LVDS (FPGA_ADC_CLOCK, unused by RTL)

g.title: out6->fpga_rx
g.text: clk_100m (processing clock; no phase relation to ADC DCO)

g.title: lotx->mixtx
g.text: J10 'LO TX' -> coax -> J23 -> C272 -> LO, 10.5 GHz

g.title: mixrx
g.text: RF = RF_RX; LO = J22 -> C274 18 pF (10.38 GHz)

g.title: lorx->mixrx
g.text: J11 'LO RX' -> coax -> J22 -> C274 -> LO, 10.38 GHz

g.title: adar
g.text: TX1..TX4 -> ADTR TX_IN; RX1..RX4 <- ADTR RX_OUT
TR / TX_LOAD / RX_LOAD / SPI from U42 bank 34 (1.8 V)

g.title: sw16
g.text: 16x M3SWA2-34DR+ (RF_SW_1..16) SPDT at each ANT port
RFOUT1 -> 1 pF -> SMA Ja; RFOUT2 -> 1 pF -> SMA Jb

g.title: bpf_tx
g.text: symbol pins: IN = RF_TX_FIL (switch side), OUT = RF_TX (U5.RF side)
(passive: pin naming does not define direction; part number NOT IDENTIFIED)

g.title: mixtx->bpf_tx
g.text: RF_TX RF = LO +/- IF: 10.5 GHz +/- 120 MHz (sideband selection by U$2: UNVERIFIED)

g.title: bpf_rx
g.text: symbol pins: IN = RF_RX (U13.RF side), OUT = RF_RX_FIL (switch side)
(passive: pin naming does not define direction; part number NOT IDENTIFIED)

g.title: adtr
g.text: TX_IN -> PA -> ANT ; ANT -> LNA -> RX_OUT

g.title: pa
g.text: RF PA board (x16): J1 RFIN -> U$1 QPA2962_B -> J2 RFOUT
(RF_PA.sch; 10 W GaN; bias VG/VD from Main Board)

g.title: sw16->pa
g.text: SMA pair per element -> PA J1 RFIN (which of the pair: UNVERIFIED)

g.title: if_lc
g.text: L3/L4 159 nH, C64/C65 25 pF, L9/L10 50 nH -> AMP_IN_P/N

g.title: adc->fpga_rx
g.text: LVDS D0..7, DCO (400 MHz), OR -> bank 14

g.title: ft601
g.text: RTL ports ft601_data[31:0], be, txe/rxf, wr/rd/oe (radar_system_top.v:79-97)

g.title: fpga_rx->ft601
g.text: 32-bit FIFO bus - NO NETS IN SCHEMATIC

g.title: host
g.text: GUI_V5.py expects FT2232H-class link, GUI_V6.py expects FT601 (0x0403:0x6030/6031)
firmware offers USB CDC only -> K3 / K5 (packet format mismatch)

g.title: stm
g.text: SPI1 (PA5/PA6/PA7) + CS PA0..PA3 -> U42 (3.3 V pass-through)
DIG_0..7 (PD8..PD15) -> U42 handshake (stm32_new_chirp/elevation/azimuth, mixers_enable: bit map inferred)
I2C1 PB6/PB7 -> DAC5578 x2 (PA gate bias); I2C2 PF0/PF1 -> ADS7830 x3 (Idq, temperatures)
I2C3 PA8/PC9 -> IMU/baro; UART5 PC12/PD2 <- GPS; USART3 PB10/PB11 debug

g.title: stm->lotx
g.text: SPI4 + TX_CS/CE/DELSTR/DELADJ/LKDET via JP13<->JP2 (K6 pin-macro conflict)

g.title: stm->host
g.text: USB 2.0 FS CDC via X53 (only wired host link; RX callback unbound: docs C4)

g.title: pabias
g.text: PA bias loop: U7/U69 DAC5578 -> OPA4703 -> VG_1..16 -> PA X2
PA X3 shunt -> INA241A3 x16 -> ADS7830 (U10/U88/U89) -> I2C2
EN/DIS_RFPA_VDD (PD6, JP10) -> 22 V drain switch (NOT IN CAD)

g.title: pabias->pa
g.text: X_n -> PA X2 VG; PA X3 -> X3/X38..X52 shunt sense
